description: This file defines a Waiter class used for managing event-based waiting, timeouts, and error handling within the Playwright core testing framework. It includes methods for waiting on events, rejecting on specific events or timeouts, logging, and error message rewriting.

classes.name: Waiter
classes.description: A class for managing asynchronous event waiting, error handling, and logging within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: createForEvent
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Waiter instance for a specific event.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to occur on an EventEmitter, optionally with a predicate.

methods.name: rejectOnEvent
methods.description: Rejects the wait if a specific event occurs, with an optional predicate.

methods.name: rejectOnTimeout
methods.description: Rejects the wait if a specified timeout elapses.

methods.name: rejectImmediately
methods.description: Immediately rejects the wait with a provided error.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and event listeners.

methods.name: waitForPromise
methods.description: Waits for a promise to resolve or reject, handling immediate errors and logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message and sends it through the channel for recording.

methods.name: _rejectOn
methods.description: Internal method to add a rejection promise to the failure list.
